svg.text: Original designer example for Exercise 8.20, printed 8-55 / PDF 433. Companion CAD and AVI unavailable.
16 browser-authored parts; dimensions assumed. RH feed lead 1 mm/rev, travel 0-20 mm; apron adjustable, clapper outward 0-20 deg.
Smooth ideal threads and fastener proxy; Steel304 substitute explicitly labeled. SH11 OD10 and SH15 socket D12.2 clearance corrections.
Material densities are references. Not load-rated; no full machine cutting-stroke model.
